description: This file defines a utility object 'SplitUtils' that provides a function to split a string into tokens based on spaces and stores the valid tokens in a linked list.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens separated by spaces and returns a linked list of valid tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the linked list if it is valid (non-empty).

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if the token is valid, i.e., not empty.
